context: Sho-young learns about classroom rules at school via talk with Asuka.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 翔くん、教室、ちゃんと使ってね。
lines.en: Sho, remember to use the classroom properly, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, affirming tone. Soft opening. A quiet teacher's directness — kind but clear. Light hand on the instruction, trusting him to listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先輩から、教わったルール、覚えてる!
lines.en: I remember the rules the seniors taught me!
lines.style: Bright, genuine eagerness. Quick attack on the opening. Proud but not boastful — a child showing he's been paying attention. Warm and unguarded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 皆と、良く協力するのも、大事。
lines.en: It's also important to work well together with everyone.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful delivery. Patient pause before the main idea. A teacher offering wisdom without lecturing — inviting him to understand rather than obey.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 玉、ボール遊び、する時の?
lines.en: Like when we play with the ball during break time?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. Rising lilt at the end — checking his understanding. Thoughtful pause before 'break time.' A child making the connection himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: うん、休み時間、安い物、皆で分けて。
lines.en: Right — during break time, we share the snacks with everyone.
lines.style: Warm affirmation with a slight smile in the voice. Soft opening on 'right.' A teacher confirming his insight gently, with quiet fondness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パン、いっぱい食べたい!
lines.en: I want to eat lots of bread!
lines.style: Bright, animated desire. Quick energy on the opening. A child's honest enthusiasm, uncomplicated and warm. No filter — just genuine want.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一般的に、お友達と分けてね。
lines.en: It's nice to share with your friends, though.
lines.style: Tender, gentle reminder. Soft landing on each word — no pressure. A teacher who knows children, meeting him where he is without dampening his joy.
